annotations.text:
DIRECTION A · Neural Constellation
Manager as a glowing core; team + analysts as depth-layered nodes wired by synapses. Cinematic, and it matches the neural look you approved before.
Tradeoff: labels get tight when all 14 nodes are lit at once.

DIRECTION B · Command Scope
A radar / mission-control instrument: radial rings, a live sweep, a side readout column. The most 'quant terminal' of the three.
Tradeoff: reads busier and less organic than a graph.

DIRECTION C · The Floor
An isometric 3D desk you orbit; each employee is a glowing station on the plane. Spatial and the most memorable.
Tradeoff: keeping labels readable at an angle is fiddly; heaviest of the three to build.

DRILL-DOWN (works with any direction)
Click a node/station and this HUD panel slides in. The analyst stats TABLE folds in here — accuracy, samples, a conviction sparkline, activity feed, and a link straight to that employee's knowledge file.
